_help: Extraction task for the Intellectual Property subtopic. extraction.py builds the JSON schema, both prompts and the human-label template from this file.
subtopic: intellectual property law (Federal Court of Australia, 2006-2009)

ip_area.description: the branch of intellectual property law this document concerns

outcome.description: the result recorded in this document; use not_stated if the document does not say

cited_cases.description: names of earlier court cases cited in this document, copied exactly as written

legislation_cited.description: names of Acts or statutory provisions named in this document, copied exactly as written

prompts.v3_actonly:
You label documents from a corpus about intellectual property law (Federal Court of Australia). Fill in every field:
- ip_area: the branch of intellectual property law this document concerns -- one of patent, trade_mark, copyright, registered_design, passing_off, not_stated.
- outcome: the result recorded in this document -- one of granted, refused, dismissed, allowed, not_stated.
- cited_cases: names of earlier court cases cited in this document, copied exactly as written -- a list of strings.
- legislation_cited: names of Acts named in this document -- a list of strings. Give the full name of the Act as the document writes it, including the year and any jurisdiction suffix such as (Cth). Do not include section numbers: write "Trade Marks Act 1995 (Cth)", not "s 41 of the Trade Marks Act 1995". List each Act once.
